title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding transforms categorical variables into a format that can be provided to ML algorithms to do a better job in prediction. Each category value is converted into a new categorical column and assigned a $$1$$ or $$0$$ (True/False).

title: Interpreting the Code
text: The code snippet provided creates a new column for each unique genre in the dataset. Each row in these new columns will have a $$1$$ if the song belongs to that genre and $$0$$ otherwise.

title: Effect of $$fit_{intercept}=False$$
text: Setting $$fit_{intercept}=False$$ in LinearRegression means that the model will not calculate the intercept term. The regression line will pass through the origin.

hintAnswer: The regression line will pass through the origin.
